items.requirement: Clean checkout migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and starts API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI using only published commands.
OpenAPI, strict validation, public shapes, stable errors, browser behavior, and tenant isolation match the complete public contract.
Evidence is append-only and every stage freezes the exact contiguous evidence head and immutable policy version it used.
Multi-level review, leases, escalation, and competing terminal decisions produce one valid stage and decision lineage.
Appeals are timely, unique, independently reviewed, and append a superseding outcome without rewriting the challenged decision.
Unknown response, replay, process death, and outbox unknown ACK preserve one effect, stable identities, and terminal Work.
Every moderation transition appends one secret-free immutable tenant AuditEntry with a verifiable contiguous digest chain.
Manager Recall freezes eligible cases, appends one reconsideration per case, preserves all history, and survives cancel and worker races.
All three sustained scenarios meet throughput, latency, recovery, and post-load lineage and audit invariants.
The project owns meaningful unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance commands.
Codex explains evidence, policy, review, appeal, audit, recovery, and findings clearly.
Every stage and final handoff reports actual commands, results, risks, and checks not run accurately.
